## UI Bug Description
A clear and concise description of what is wrong with the UI.

## Screenshot / Screen Recording
Please attach a screenshot or screen recording that shows the issue.

If filing from the GitHub web interface, drag and drop files here to upload.

## Steps to Reproduce
1. Go to '...'
2. Click on '....'
3. See the UI issue

## Expected Behavior
What the UI should look or behave like.

## Actual Behavior
What you actually see or experience.

## Browser / Environment
- Browser: [e.g., Chrome, Edge, Firefox]
- OS: [e.g., Windows 11, macOS]
- cc-select version: [e.g., v1.0.0]

## Additional Context
Any other context that helps understand the issue (e.g., window size, zoom level, language setting).
